correctness.rationale: Published arbitrary-parameter facet system (Bayer et al., Thm 2.3(c)) plus all halfspace Euclidean distances establish r=min A_k/(k+sqrt(k)); uniform (1+r) center attains every bound. Any active k forces equality of all coordinates, and redundancy at b1=1 is inactive because A_n=A_(n-1) and the denominator increases. The one-spike construction g_c(t) has derivative with unique minimum at arbitrary k, and strict inequalities survive rational perturbation and integral scaling. The completed verify.py independently solved 121 full-halfspace Chebyshev linear programs including 20 target-rank witnesses.

value.rationale: Inscribed-ball geometry is a natural Euclidean invariant on the studied arbitrary-parameter parking-function family. The exact complete contact-orbit spectrum and the theorem that every intermediate rank is uniquely realized on a robust open parameter region give a genuinely structural classification beyond the previously known two-phase special case. An explicit n=3 intermediate-rank witness demonstrates the phenomenon; this is not merely finite enumeration or an arbitrary restricted slice.
